verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Unreal Editor is a visual environment for building content. It supports shared editor sessions for "building a single virtual world," games created "entirely within the editor," painting tile maps, placed volumes, and testing the currently loaded Level from the toolbar. However, no evidence explicitly documents the viewport, a property inspector/details panel, or prefab-style scene composition. missing for 10: explicit viewport documentation, inspector/details-panel documentation, prefab/reusable scene-composition evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of editor-first level building.

support.subject: As a technical artist, a full visual editor — viewport, inspector, prefabs/scene composition — is the primary way to build levels

citations.quote: Get multiple users on different computers into a shared Unreal Editor session, collaborating live to build content together.
a sprite-based system for creating 2D and 2D/3D hybrid games entirely within the editor
